title: 32 MINUTES PRAYERS TO COMMAND THE NEW WEEK BY FIRE
text: Before 7 in the morning, before the city is fully awake, before the traffic starts, before the emails begin, before the phone fills with the world's demands, before the week has opened its mouth to speak its version over your life, you are going to paralyze every demon assigned to your week. Not weaken them, not slow them down, not slightly inconvenience their operations. Paralyze. Paralysis means unable to move. Paralysis means the assignment exists, but cannot be executed. Paralysis means the spirit is present, but the power to operate is gone. The demon assigned to your marriage this week paralyzed. The demon assigned to your finances this week paralyzed. The demon assigned to your mind this week paralyzed. The demon assigned to your body this week paralyzed. The demon assigned to your children this week paralyzed. The demon assigned to your destiny this week paralyzed. Unable to move, unable to execute, unable to land a single assignment. Because you showed up before 7 in the morning and you prayed this prayer, and the authority of the name of Jesus went before you into every day of this week. Hear me, this is not aggressive language for the sake of energy. This is scriptural precision. Luke chapter 10 verse 19. Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Tread on. The Greek is pateo, to walk upon, to trample, to crush under foot. Not to negotiate with the serpent, not to coexist peacefully with the scorpion, to tread on it, to place the foot of covenant authority directly on the assignment, and apply the weight of the name of Jesus until it cannot move. That is what paralysis is. It is the foot of the believer on the neck of the enemy's assignment. And this prayer is the act of treading. Before this prayer ends, share it. Not politely, as a weapon. There is someone in your network who woke up this Monday and felt something they cannot explain. A weight, a dread, a low hum of anxiety that was there before the first thought formed. That is not emotion, that is a demon that got there before prayer did. Send them this word. Tell them the paralysis prayer is here. The demon that arrived first is about to be rendered immobile. Send it now, the war room is waiting. Now, I want to teach you something. Before we pray, I want to give you the theology of paralysis in the spirit realm, because you cannot exercise an authority you do not understand. And you cannot paralyze what you have not first identified. The scripture reveals that demonic beings are assigned. They are not random, they are not opportunistic wanderers. They are deployed with specific assignments against specific targets. Daniel chapter 10, the most explicit revelation of this principle in all of scripture. Daniel prays, heaven responds immediately, verse 12. From the first day that Daniel set his heart to understand, the answer was dispatched. But the answer was delayed 21 days, verse 13, because the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood the angelic messenger. Prince of the kingdom of Persia, a demonic principality specifically assigned to a territory, not a generic dark spirit wandering through the atmosphere, an assigned territorial, purposeful demonic being. Whose specific job was to prevent the answer from reaching Daniel. And it held the answer for 21 days. Now, hear this. This is the revelation that changes everything. Daniel did not know about the resistance. He did not know there was a principality withstanding his answer. He just knew the answer had not arrived, and he kept praying. But imagine if Daniel had known about the prince of Persia. If he had specifically addressed the principality holding the answer, if he had named it and paralyzed it by name, could the answer have arrived on day one instead of day 21? Thus said the spirit of God, there are answers that have been dispatched from heaven for your life that have not arrived yet. Not because God did not send them, because a demonic assignment has been withstanding them. Like the prince of Persia withstood Daniel's answer. And this prayer, the paralysis prayer, is the prayer that addresses the withstanding, that names the principality, that treads on the assignment, that paralyzes what has been holding back what heaven already released. There are three categories of demonic assignment you will paralyze in this prayer. Category one, principalities. Ephesians chapter six verse 12. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Principalities, archons in the Greek, are the highest ranking demonic forces. They are territorial, they govern regions, cities, bloodlines. They have been operating against some of the people under this prayer for generations. Not just against you, against your parents, your grandparents, the family line before you, creating patterns, establishing cycles, enforcing limitations. The same poverty in every generation, the same marriage failure in every generation, the same sickness visiting every generation. That is a principality with a generational assignment, and today it is being paralyzed. Category two, powers. Powers, exousias, are the middle ranking forces. They are the ones who execute the principality strategy at the ground level. The spirit of fear that operates in the mind, the spirit of infirmity that operates in the body, the spirit of poverty that operates in the finances, the spirit of strife that operates in the relationships. These are powers specific, functional, operational, assigned to specific areas. And today they are being paralyzed in every area. Category three, rulers of darkness. The cosmocrators, world rulers of this darkness. The spirits that govern the systems and structures that work against the people of God. The spirit behind the system that makes advancement difficult. The spirit behind the institution that creates obstacles. The spirit behind the cultural current that moves against the kingdom. And today they are being paralyzed. Three categories, all three present in your week. All three addressed in this prayer. All three paralyzed before 7 in the morning. Let us pray. Stand where you are. Lift your hands open, not clenched. Open because you are also receiving as you release. Open because the posture of the warrior is also the posture of the inheritor. Father, we come before 7 in the morning on a Monday. We come through the blood of Jesus Christ. The blood that never loses its voice. Hebrews 12:24. The blood that gives us boldness. Hebrews 10:19. To enter the throne room not as visitors, but as sons. We come with the authority of Luke 10:19. You gave it to us. We receive it. We activate it. Over all the power of the enemy, nothing shall by any means hurt us. This is not a claim we are making for the first time. It is a covenant reality we are enforcing, and we enforce it now. Paralyzing the principalities in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, the one who was dead and is alive forevermore. Revelation 1:18. And who holds the keys of hell and death. I address every principality assigned to these lives. I address the generational principality operating through the bloodline, the territorial spirit that has been enforcing patterns of limitation for generations. The poverty pattern that moved from grandfather to father to this generation. The sickness pattern that visits every generation with the same diagnosis. The marriage failure pattern that has repeated itself in every household. The early death pattern. The addiction pattern. The shame pattern. Every generational principality, I address you now. Colossians 2:15. Having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. Spoiled. Openly triumphed over. At the cross, Jesus made a public spectacle of every principality. Your authority was stripped there. Your legal basis was demolished there. And I am enforcing that verdict right now. Generational principality, you are paralyzed. You cannot move through this bloodline anymore. The pattern ends with this generation. The cycle ends in this household. The generational assignment is paralyzed. Unable to move, unable to operate, unable to pass the pattern to the next generation. I address the territorial principality over the city, the region, the sphere of life where God has placed these servants. The principality that has been creating systemic resistance against advancement. The spirit that controls access to certain rooms and certain circles. The force that has been making the calling feel impossible in this specific environment. I do not move the person, I move the principality. I do not relocate the assignment. I paralyze the resistance. Territorial principality, in the name of Jesus, paralyzed. Unable to block what God has opened, unable to shut what God has unlocked. Unable to enforce the limitations of the territory over the life of the covenant child. There is a person under this voice. They have tried everything the natural mind can suggest. Change the strategy, change the approach, change the team. And still the same ceiling, the same wall, the same invisible resistance. The Lord says you have been wrestling with flesh and blood, but the problem was never flesh and blood. The problem was the principality behind the system. And today that principality is paralyzed, not slowed, paralyzed. And the door that was being held shut by an invisible force is now being held shut by nothing. I decree push the door this week. It opens, paralyzing the powers. Now we address the functional spirits, the powers operating in specific areas. Paralyze the spirit of fear. Fear phobos in the Greek is not an emotion. It is a spirit. 2 Timothy 1 to 7. God has not given us the spirit of fear. A spirit has a will, a strategy, an assignment. The spirit of fear assigned to this week has a specific plan. To make the believer paralyzed by what might happen so that the enemy can do what is actually happening unopposed. The enemy's most effective weapon is not the attack itself. It is the fear of the attack. Fear immobilizes the believer. Fear drains the faith that activates the covering. Fear keeps the mouth shut that should be declaring. Fear keeps the hands down that should be lifted. And today we paralyze the spirit of fear. Spirit of fear, in the name of Jesus, paralyzed. You cannot move through my thought life this week. You cannot land in my decisions this week. You cannot govern my responses this week. Paralyzed, immobile, powerless, in the name of Jesus. And in the space vacated by fear, I receive the spirit God did I do give. Power, love, a sound mind. 2 Timothy 1 to 7. Into every space fear occupied, power enters. Into every space fear occupied, love enters. Into every space fear occupied, sound mind enters. Paralyze the spirit of poverty. Poverty is not just a financial condition. Poverty is a spirit, an assignment to limit, to restrict, to drain, to prevent abundance. It operates in the finances, but it also operates in the mind, creating a poverty mindset that rejects blessing even when it arrives. It operates in the spirit creating a smallness, a shrinking from the full inheritance. Spirit of poverty, I address you now. Deuteronomy 8:18. It is the Lord who gives power to get wealth. The power to get wealth is resident in the covenant child. And you, spirit of poverty, have no covenant basis to operate here. The cause of poverty was broken at the cross. Galatians 3:13. Christ has redeemed us from the cause of the law. The poverty cause redeemed. The legal basis of the spirit eliminated. Spirit of poverty paralyzed this week and going forward. Unable to restrict the flow of blessing, unable to drain the financial containers. Unable to prevent the advancement of the covenant child into abundance. Paralyze the spirit of infirmity. Luke 13:11. A woman with a spirit of infirmity, 18 years, bowed together. 18 years bent double, not a natural condition, a spirit. Jesus did not prescribe medicine. He did not recommend physiotherapy. He addressed the spirit. Thou art loose from thine infirmity. And the woman was made straight immediately. Spirit of infirmity assigned to these bodies this week, I address you now. In the name of Jesus, paralyzed. You cannot bow this body down this week. You cannot increase the symptoms. You cannot intensify the affliction. You cannot recruit new areas of the body into your assignment. Paralyzed, immobile, powerless. And I speak healing into every body this prayer is touching. Isaiah 53:5. With his stripes we are healed. The healing is not future, it was purchased, past tense. I am calling it into present tense manifestation right now. There is a person praying this prayer, they have a medical appointment this week. A test, a scan, a follow-up that has been carrying weight. They have not told many people about it. They have been carrying the anxiety of what the result might say. The Lord says the report does not have the final word. I do. I am the Lord who healeth thee. Exodus 15:26. Jehovah Rapha, I paralyze the spirit of infirmity before the appointment. And I speak to the report that comes out of that appointment. It will tell a different story than what the enemy planned. I decree good news comes from that appointment. The doctor will be surprised, and the testimony will be undeniable. Paralyze the spirit of strife and division. James chapter 3:16. For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. Every evil work. Strife is not just relational tension. Strife is the open door through which every evil work enters. Every other assignment the enemy has, it enters through the door of strife. Which is why he works so hard to create it. In the marriage, in the family, in the ministry, in the workplace, if he can get strife operating, everything else follows. Spirit of strife assigned to the relationships under this prayer. Paralyzed, in the name of Jesus. You cannot ignite conflict in my marriage this week. You cannot manufacture offense in my family this week. You cannot introduce division into my ministry relationships this week. The door through which every evil work enters shut, sealed by the blood. And Philippians 4:7. The peace of God which passeth all understanding shall guard the hearts and minds. Into every relationship under this prayer, the peace of God as a garrison standing guard, refusing entrance to the spirit of strife. This week the marriages are stronger than before the week started. This week the family is more united than the enemy planned. Paralyze the spirit of delay. Like the prince of Persia that withstood Daniel's answer, there is a spirit of delay that has been withstanding the answers to these prayers. The breakthrough that has been at the door, the provision that has been prepared but not released, the open door that has been held shut by an unseen hand, the answer to the prayer that heaven dispatched months ago, but something in the spirit realm has been withstanding its arrival. Spirit of delay, in the name of Jesus, paralyzed. The withstanding is over. The resistance is dismantled. What heaven released now arrives. What has been held back now breaks through. The 21-day delay is ending this Monday morning. Michael and the host of heaven as they came for Daniel. Come now to enforce the breakthrough. The answer that has been in transit arrives this week. The blessing that has been assembled releases this week. The door that has been almost open opens fully this week, paralyzing the rulers of darkness. The cosmocrators, the world rulers, the systems and structures that the enemy has built to work against the advancement of God's people. I address the spirit behind the system that has been blocking advancement. The bureaucratic darkness, the institutional resistance. The cultural current that flows against the kingdom assignment, the spirit behind the close network, the gated room, the inaccessible circle. Ruler of darkness behind the system, paralyzed. You cannot maintain the blockade this week. You cannot keep the door closed this week. You cannot hold the network exclusive this week. Isaiah 22:22. The key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder. So he shall open and none shall shut. And he shall shut and none shall open. The key of David is in the hands of Jesus. And what he opens the cosmocrator cannot shut. I speak to every door that the ruler of darkness has been holding shut. The door to the promotion, the door to the contract, the door to the platform, the door to the community that the assignment requires, the door to the healing, the door to the relationship that changes the trajectory. Ruler of darkness is paralyzed and the door opens. I address the spirit of spiritual wickedness in high places, the high altitude demonic activity that operates above ground level, the coordinated cosmic assignments against the purposes of God in this generation. Ephesians 6:10, be strong in the Lord and in the power of his might, not in the power of my might, his might, the strength of the one who sits far above all principality and power and might and dominion. Ephesians 1:21, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but in the world to come. Far above all, there is no demonic rank that is above Jesus. There is no spiritual wickedness in any high place that is not subordinate to the name of Jesus. And in that name, spiritual wickedness in high places paralyzed. Now the full decree. Father, every category has been addressed. The principalities paralyzed, the powers paralyzed, the rulers of darkness paralyzed. We have treaded on the serpent and scorpions. We have placed the foot of covenant authority on every assignment. We have enforced the verdict of Colossians 2:15 that every principality was spoiled and publicly triumphed over at the cross. Now in the cleared space, we establish what fear occupied power, love and sound mind now occupies. What poverty occupied the blessing of the Lord that maketh rich now occupies. Proverbs 10:22. What infirmity occupied divine health and the healing of Jehovah Rapha now occupies. What strife occupied the peace of God as a garrison now occupies. What delay occupied divine acceleration and the on-time God now occupies. What the ruler of darkness blocked the open door of the key of David now occupies. And I decree a week that looks nothing like what the enemy assembled. I decree divine momentum for this week. Momentum, what was stationary begins to move. What was slow accelerates. What was stuck breaks free. The momentum of heaven behind every step taken in obedience this week. I decree unexpected favor this week. The favor that has no natural explanation. The goodness of God showing up in rooms you did not know you were being considered for. Psalm 23:6, surely goodness and mercy shall follow me. Follow, present, persistent, pursuing. The goodness is not ahead of you, it is following you. Into every room of this week, goodness and mercy as your escort. I decree angelic reinforcement for this week. Hebrews 1:14, ministering spirits sent to minister to the heirs of salvation. The angels assigned to this life released into full operational deployment. Before me on every road, angelic escort. Around my children on every journey, angelic cover. Over my home every night, angelic watch. In every meeting, every conversation, every high stakes moment this week, the host of heaven is present and active. There is a young woman under this voice. She has been fighting alone. Not alone in the natural, surrounded by people, but in the spirit fighting without reinforcement because she did not know the angels were available. Because no one ever told her that Hebrews 1:14 was personal. That the ministering spirits are not a distant theological concept. They are assigned to her specifically, personally. The Lord says you have been fighting outnumbered not because you were, but because you did not know the reinforcement was there. It has always been there. 2 Kings 6:17, open her eyes, Lord, that she may see. The mountain is full of horses and chariots of fire. They are surrounding her this week, right now. I decree the lone fighter anointing lifts. The reinforcement becomes visible in its effects. This week she begins to win in ways that cannot be explained by her own capacity alone. Father, we thank you. We thank you that we showed up before 7 inches the morning. We thank you that the window was open. We thank you that the authority of Luke 10:19 is not theoretical. It is operational, present tense, fully active in the name of Jesus. We thank you for the name. Philippians 2:29, the name above every name. Every principality has a name. Every power has a name. Every ruler of darkness has a name and there is a name above every one of them, Jesus. And that name is in our mouths. And that name has been applied to every demon assigned to this week and every one of them is paralyzed. Shondai Ecclesia Tumbala. Rekai Shondai Tumbala Ecclesia Re Shondai Ecclesia Kai Tumbala Shondai Re Ecclesia Kai. The siege is over. It is before 7 inches the morning and every demon assigned to your week is paralyzed. Not weakened, paralyzed. Not inconvenienced, paralyzed. Unable to move, unable to execute, unable to deploy a single assignment against a single day of this week. The generational principality paralyzed, the territorial principality paralyzed, the spirit of fear paralyzed, the spirit of poverty paralyzed, the spirit of infirmity paralyzed, the spirit of strife paralyzed, the spirit of delay paralyzed. The rulers of darkness behind the systems paralyzed, spiritual wickedness in high places paralyzed. And in the paralyzed enemy's place, power, love, sound mind, commanded blessing, divine health, the peace that guards, acceleration of the breakthrough, open doors, angelic reinforcement. The goodness and mercy that follow as an escort walk into your favor. It has been waiting. Not at the end of the week, Monday before 7:00 now. The favor did not wait for you to deserve it. It waited for you to enforce it and you just did. Your destiny is preserved by the blood. Your week is governed by the paralysis prayer. The prince of Persia that was withstanding your answers paralyzed and the answer heaven dispatched is now arriving without resistance. I decree this is the week the Daniel breakthrough arrives. The answer that has been in transit breaks through. The 21 days of withstanding end this morning. Before 7:00 a.m., before the city woke up, before the enemy could reassemble, you paralyzed the withstanding and now the answer moves freely. From this altar you go as one who has tread on serpents and scorpions. Not one who hopes the enemy leaves them alone, one who has left the enemy immobile. Not a reactor, a paralyzer. The one who got to the assignment before the assignment could get to them. Kai Tumbala Shondai Ecclesia Re Kai Ecclesia Shondai Tumbala Re Shondai Kai Ecclesia Shondai Tumbala Ecclesia Re Kai. It is done. Every demon assigned to this week paralyzed. Every principality paralyzed. Every power paralyzed. Every ruler of darkness paralyzed. Every withstanding spirit paralyzed. And the week that remains belongs entirely to God. Go before 7 inches the morning into a week where every demon assigned to it cannot move. They are not gone. They are paralyzed and there is a difference. Paralyzed means present but powerless. Present but unable to execute. Present but forced to watch the covenant child advance through every day of this week unharmed, unhindered, and undefeated. That is the testimony of the before 7:00 a.m. prayer. That is what you just did. Amen and amen.
